promos.title: The Altar Betrayal
promos.description: Lady Juliana arrives in her late mother's vintage gown for her dream wedding, only to discover her fiancé Gerald holding her sister's hand at the altar. A devastating public humiliation turns into an unyielding vow of defiance.
promos.hook: Juliana steps radiant through cathedral doors into church silence—until Matriarch steps forward: 'You should turn around, Juliana.'

segments.source_text: You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!

promos.main_conflict: Altar betrayal by betrothed Gerald with the full cruel conspiracy of her own family
promos.cliffhanger: Gerald coldly states 'I changed my mind' as Juliana's eyes harden from tears into icy vengeance.
promos.why_it_works: Explosive 3-second hook that subverts the traditional wedding entrance. Visceral family betrayal, razor-sharp dialogue, and high visual contrast between white gown and gold dress.

promos.title: The Stranger's Proposal
promos.description: Cast aside by Gerald and ordered seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana's ruin is interrupted by an imposing scarred warrior who draws steel—and drops to one knee.
promos.hook: Juliana is dragged toward cathedral guards—until heavy doors blow open and a scarred stranger cuts them down with lethal grace.

segments.source_text: I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value... when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county.
I didn't steal what was never truly yours.

promos.main_conflict: Abandonment by high society vs intervention by a lethal, honorable stranger
promos.cliffhanger: The mysterious warrior kneels before the ruined bride in front of the horrified congregation.
promos.why_it_works: Multi-episode structure proves the hero's fall and unexpected savior arc. The ultimate romance/revenge hook that drives 80%+ click-through rates in vertical ads.

promos.title: Low Value Bride
promos.description: Gerald publicly proclaims Juliana of 'plainness and low value' before high society, igniting the defiant spark that sets off the entire microdrama.
promos.hook: Gerald towers over Juliana: 'You have nothing to offer me anymore.'

segments.source_text: So that is what I was worth to you?
You have nothing to offer me anymore.
I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value... when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county.

promos.main_conflict: Arrogant noble discarding loyal betrothed for beauty and wealth
promos.cliffhanger: Juliana's tearful blue eyes harden into cold defiance as string drone swells.
promos.why_it_works: High-contrast lines with strong moral clarity. Viewers instantly want to binge watch the revenge arc.

promos.title: Sister in Gold
promos.description: Clarissa gloats in her gold gown as she steals her sister's husband and societal standing. A venomous sibling rivalry reaches its breaking point before the entire high society congregation.
promos.hook: Clarissa smirks beside the altar candles: 'I am the daughter they choose.'

segments.source_text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to. I am the daughter they choose.

promos.main_conflict: Favored cruel sister vs rejected, pure-hearted protagonist
promos.cliffhanger: Clarissa's chilling declaration cuts to Juliana refusing to break down before the congregation.
promos.why_it_works: Classic microdrama antagonist archetype. Short, punchy lines that trigger intense outrage and viral engagement on TikTok/Reels.

promos.title: The Father's Silence
promos.description: Humiliated and abandoned by Gerald, Juliana drops to her knees in front of her elderly father's pew, begging him to speak—only to face stone-cold family betrayal.
promos.hook: Juliana on her knees in tears: 'Father... please look at me!' Her father stares ahead in cold silence.

segments.source_text: Tell them this is a mistake.
You have embarrassed this family long enough.

promos.main_conflict: Daughter seeking parental protection vs family casting her out for status
promos.cliffhanger: Matriarch proclaims her an embarrassment as Juliana realizes she has no family left.
promos.why_it_works: Extremely relatable emotional wound. Focuses on the heartbreak of family loyalty discarded for greed.
